mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag on corporate earnings and equity prices, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating industrial production index signals strengthening economic activity that will boost corporate earnings and equity prices, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of months following an INDPRO acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market that will drag on consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening yield curve (10Y-2Y spread) signals a tightening financial conditions that will compress equity valuations and produce negative S&P 500 returns, especially if accompanied by an inverted curve.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of months following a yield curve inversion.

mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts signals a strengthening residential investment sector that will boost economic activity and equity prices, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate signals an improving labor market that will boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 45% of months following a UNRATE decline.

mechanism_narrative: A slowdown in industrial production signals weakening economic activity that will drag on corporate earnings and equity prices, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising unemployment.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of months following an INDPRO slowdown and UNRATE rise.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index signals building inflationary pressures that will erode real equity returns and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising interest rates.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of months following a CPI surge and FEDFUNDS hike.
